title: Human-Centered Learning Mechanics: Observable Entropy Control under Protected-Risk Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2605.22940v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Entropy reduction is not a safety criterion: it can leave predictions unchanged or accompany increasing risk for a protected group. We study entropy-regulated learning under separately specified task, risk, and intervention constraints. A noise-calibrated log-determinant functional yields an exact spectral force formula and a metric decomposition into observable and prediction-null velocities. For scalar feedback, we characterize the complete interval of coefficients preserving a task-descent fraction and meeting an entropy-rate request; restricting intervention to observable directions can make that interval empty. For several protected risks, we derive an exact minimax certificate of feasibility within a specified subspace and norm budget, an exact robust extension for uncertain constraint rows, and a cone-projection formula for the entropy reduction remaining after protection. translated_title: 以人为中心的学习力学：受保护风险约束下的可观测熵控制
translated_abstract: 熵降低并非一个安全准则：它可能使预测保持不变，或伴随着受保护群体风险的上升。我们研究在分别指定的任务、风险与干预约束下的熵调控学习。一个经噪声校准的对数行列式泛函给出了精确的谱力公式，以及将速度度量分解为可观测分量与预测零空间分量的方法。对于标量反馈，我们刻画了在保持任务下降比例并满足熵速率要求时系数的完整区间；而将干预限制在可观测方向上可能使该区间为空。对于多个受保护风险，我们在指定子空间与范数预算内推导出精确的极小极大可行性证书、针对不确定约束行的精确鲁棒扩展，以及保护后剩余熵削减的锥投影公式。这些公式采用标准的凸几何方法，但……
tldr: 本文建立了在任务、风险与干预约束分离设定下的熵调控学习理论，通过噪声校准的对数行列式泛函导出精确谱力公式、可观测/预测零空间速度分解、标量反馈系数完整区间，以及多受保护风险下的极小极大可行性证书与锥投影公式，实现受保护风险约束下的可观测熵控制。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a theory of entropy-regulated learning under separately specified task, risk, and intervention constraints, deriving exact spectral force formulas, an observable/prediction-null velocity decomposition, complete coefficient intervals for scalar feedback, and minimax feasibility certificates with cone-projection formulas for protected risks, enabling observable entropy control under protected-risk constraints.
